title: Byte Engine terrain asset
description: A standalone terrain asset that bakes a height map into a tree of node meshes that load one at a time.

$schema.description: The local JSON Schema reference for this asset.

height_map.description: The asset-root-relative ID of a PNG or EXR image whose samples are the terrain's heights. Use 16-bit PNG or EXR.

material.description: The ID of the .bema variant every node draws with.

spacing.description: Meters between neighboring samples, along X and along Z.

heights.description: The height in meters of a sample whose value is 0, then of one whose value is 1. The first must be lower.

tile_size.description: Quads along each side of a node.
